A Grave Mistake#000.src: I have nothing more to say. Take these.
A Grave Mistake#000.dst: 我没有别的话要说了。把这些拿去。

similar.text: I have nothing more to say.

A Grave Mistake#001.src: Thank you again for all of your help!
A Grave Mistake#001.dst: 再次谢谢你的一切帮忙！

A Grave Mistake#003.src: But since you have made it thus far, I suppose I shall show you the truth...
A Grave Mistake#003.dst: 不过既然你走到了这一步，我想我该让你看看真相……

A Grave Mistake#004.src: Then leave, and forget the horrors you have witnessed here today...
A Grave Mistake#004.dst: 那就离开吧，忘掉你今天在这里目睹的一切恐怖……
A Grave Mistake#004.speaker: Mael

A Grave Mistake#005.src: Keep in mind what you have learned.

A Grave Mistake#007.src: There is nothing in this graveyard.
A Grave Mistake#007.dst: 这片墓地里什么都没有。
A Grave Mistake#007.speaker: Alem

A Grave Mistake#012.src: Where di.. my arm.? I need my a... I had it somewh... upstairs?
A Grave Mistake#012.dst: 我的手臂.. 去哪.了？我需要我的手…… 我放在某个地…… 楼上？
A Grave Mistake#012.speaker: XXXXXXX

A Grave Mistake#013.src: You were warned not to enter this forsaken place.
A Grave Mistake#013.dst: 早就警告过你，不要进入这个被遗弃的地方。

A Grave Mistake#017.src: Ooh.. oh... another victim... Welcome... there is no need for a quick introduction... ... you will have just time enough now...
A Grave Mistake#017.dst: 噢.. 噢…… 又一个受害者…… 欢迎…… 不必急着自我介绍…… …… 你现在的时间刚刚好……
A Grave Mistake#017.speaker: Skull

A Grave Mistake#018.src: After all... you just fell into a grave... but, let us make it a little comfortable... where shall I bite first?!
A Grave Mistake#018.dst: 毕竟…… 你刚掉进了坟墓…… 不过，让我们弄得舒服点…… 我先咬哪里好呢？！
A Grave Mistake#018.speaker: Skull
